title: Require canonical full signer keys in SCHC authenticated sessions
description: Security codereview found AuthenticatedSessionContext accepts any nonempty identity bytes, allowing callers to bind IID/truncated/inconsistent identity representations instead of the verified full signer public key. Use the canonical verifier identity representation (fixed 32-byte Ed25519 signer public key, with one canonical local representation), reject alternate lengths/encodings, and test aliases cannot satisfy a pubkey-bound session.
